title: Store Manager - NYC
description:
Position Overview: We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Store Manager to lead the operations of our innovative Heytea store. As the store's leader, you will be responsible for overseeing daily operations, developing team members, and driving excellent customer experiences. title: Business Development Coordinator
description:
About Us
We are a fast-growing tea beverage brand with an expanding retail and franchise presence across the U.S. Our mission is to bring high-quality, innovative, and culturally inspired tea experiences to our customers. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Business Development Coordinator to keep our site selection, leasing, and franchise expansion projects on track.

Position Overview
This is an execution- and coordination-focused role, not a sales or deal-origination position. The Business Development Coordinator is the person who makes sure our expansion pipeline actually moves: tracking every open item, chasing pending responses, keeping project records and documents accurate and current, and maintaining clear, professional communication with brokers, landlords, property managers, and internal teams.
You will not be asked to prospect, pitch, or negotiate deals. Instead, you will own the follow-up: knowing at any moment what each project is waiting on, who owes what, and what happens next. The ideal candidate is highly responsive, methodical, and detail-driven, with strong written communication and the judgment to know what needs internal confirmation before anything is committed externally.

Key Responsibilities
Project follow-up and pending item tracking
Track the status, open items, and deadlines of every active site selection, leasing, and franchise expansion project; maintain a clear picture of what each project is waiting on and who is responsible.
Proactively follow up on pending responses, missing documents, and unresolved next steps — without needing reminders — and escalate items at risk of stalling.
Manage multiple concurrent projects and contact threads, advancing them by priority rather than working task by task.
Run and maintain the BD pipeline tracker, project status reports, and to-do lists; keep updates timely and accurate so leadership always has a current view.
Stakeholder communication
Serve as a reliable day-to-day contact for brokers, landlords, property managers, and franchise-related parties; respond promptly and keep all threads moving.
Draft clear, professional English emails and routine business correspondence; confirm details, request missing information, and document agreed next steps.
Coordinate with internal teams (legal, operations, training, marketing, finance) to obtain reviews, approvals, and deliverables needed to keep projects on schedule.
Prepare meeting notes and action-item summaries; circulate follow-ups and verify that agreed actions are completed.
Document and information accuracy
Maintain organized, complete, and version-controlled project files, including LOIs, lease-related materials, franchise documents, and correspondence records.
Review incoming and outgoing materials for completeness — spot missing attachments, outdated versions, unanswered questions, and undefined next steps before they cause delays.
Exercise sound judgment on what information requires internal confirmation before being shared externally; never commit to terms, timelines, or conditions outside of approved scope.
General support
Provide flexible support in line with BD team rhythms, including occasional after-hours meetings, urgent follow-ups, or weekend support as needed.
Complete ad-hoc tasks and assignments delegated by the leadership team in a timely and high-quality manner.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree required.
2–3 years of experience in coordination- or support-oriented roles such as sales coordination, business development support, client service, account coordination, project coordination, leasing/real estate support, or commercial property/mall support. Real estate or site-selection experience is a plus but not required.
Demonstrated follow-through: a track record of closing loops, chasing pending items to resolution, and keeping projects moving without supervision or reminders.
Proven ability to track and advance multiple projects and multiple points of contact simultaneously, with clear prioritization.
Excellent written English; able to communicate clearly and professionally with brokers, landlords, and property managers.
High attention to detail and strong sensitivity to information completeness, document versions, and record accuracy.
Structured and process-minded; comfortable building and maintaining trackers, pipelines, checklists, and meeting documentation.
Service-oriented with sound business judgment; understands what needs verification and what should not be promised.
Comfortable with the pace of a business development function, including occasional after-hours or weekend availability.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint); experience with project trackers or CRM tools is a plus.

What We Offer
Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
Health, dental, and vision insurance.
Employee discount on our tea products.
A collaborative and entrepreneurial team environment.
Remote work
Exposure to the full retail expansion process — site selection, leasing, and franchise development — with clear room to grow within the BD function.

title: Operations Support Supervisor
description:
Position Summary
The Area Operations Support Supervisor plays a critical role in supporting regional store operations by driving execution of corporate initiatives, analyzing operational performance, and improving efficiency across stores. This role partners closely with regional operations leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure operational excellence, data-driven decision-making, and consistent execution of company standards.

Key Responsibilities
Operational Initiatives Execution & Performance Diagnostics
Track and monitor the execution of regional operational initiatives and corporate programs on a quarterly basis
Collect, consolidate, and analyze operational data to ensure effective implementation of company strategies at the regional level
Identify operational gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities through data analysis and store feedback
Develop actionable solutions tailored to local market conditions and drive execution with cross-functional stakeholders
New Product Launch & Campaign Management
Coordinate pre-launch readiness for new products, including materials preparation, training support, and system setup
Monitor post-launch performance and conduct data-driven reviews to optimize future product and promotional strategies
Inventory & Materials Management
Support regional inventory tracking and reporting processes
Maintain and monitor locally sourced materials and supplier-related information
Provide insights and recommendations to improve supply chain efficiency and operational effectiveness
Labor & Workforce Efficiency Analysis
Assist in monitoring labor hours and workforce utilization across the region
Analyze labor efficiency metrics (e.g., labor cost, productivity) and provide actionable insights to operations leadership
Support initiatives aimed at optimizing labor allocation while maintaining operational standards
Financial & Margin Analysis (P&L Support)
Prepare and deliver weekly and monthly gross margin reports for the region
Monitor financial performance, identify variances, and partner with operations to implement corrective actions
Maintain and enhance margin calculation tools to support franchise/partner store financial management capabilities
Meeting Coordination & Execution Follow-Up
Organize and facilitate regional operations meetings
Prepare data and materials in advance and document clear meeting minutes
Track follow-up actions to ensure accountability and completion of key initiatives
Systems & Operational Infrastructure Management
Manage system access and permissions based on business needs to ensure data accuracy and security
Coordinate updates to operating hours across digital platforms (e.g., app, online ordering systems)
Support store setup needs, including email account creation and maintenance of operational tracking tools
Partner Relations & Compliance Support
Assist in managing partner/franchise compliance with company policies and operational standards
Support documentation and communication related to policy violations, including issuance of formal notices
Prepare and distribute periodic compliance summaries to maintain operational discipline and transparency
Cross-Functional Store Experience Program
Organize and coordinate store immersion programs for corporate and support functions
Enhance cross-functional understanding of store operations and improve collaboration between teams

Qualifications
Education & Experience:
Bachelor’s degree or above; minimum of 3 years of experience in F&B operations, retail operations support, store management, or supply chain-related roles
Bilingual Communication:
Fluency in both English and Mandarin Chinese required, with strong written and verbal communication skills to collaborate with global headquarters and local teams
Data & Analytical Skills:
Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; ability to independently analyze data and generate actionable reports (weekly/monthly)
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends and recommend solutions
Project Management:
Proven experience leading or supporting regional or cross-functional projects
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and execution discipline
Mobility:
Valid U.S. driver’s license preferred; ability to travel within the region for store visits and meetings as needed
Work Environment & Expectations
Fast-paced, multi-unit retail/food service environment
Requires strong cross-functional collaboration and adaptability
Role may require periodic travel within different states

title: Tea Barista Full-time
description:
164 Ludlow Matcha Lab is coming soon and is now hiring both full-time and part-time crew members!!

Address: 164 Ludlow St, New York, NY 10002

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare and serve a variety of freshly made tea beverages, including those made with fruits, milk, tea, tapioca pearls, and other creative toppings, following established recipes and quality standards.
Ensure the correct ingredients and proportions are used for each drink, including tea, milk, fresh fruits, tapioca pearls, and other toppings.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the barista station, including prepping ingredients (e.g., cutting fruits) and cleaning equipment.
Provide excellent customer service by greeting customers, taking orders, and offering recommendations.
Assist in inventory management, ensuring all ingredients (including fruits) and supplies are stocked and stored properly.

Support store operations as needed, including working overtime hours when required by business needs and in compliance with applicable labor laws.
Stay updated on new menu items, seasonal specials, and promotions to enhance the customer experience.
Perform other duties as assigned by the Store Manager or Supervisor.

Shift Expectations
Day Shift: Team members are expected to arrive on time and complete opening preparation tasks, including setup and ingredient prep. This role requires strong time management skills and a high sense of responsibility.
Night Shift: Team members will support closing operations, including end-of-day cleaning and organizing tasks. Night shifts are eligible for a shift allowance, in accordance with company policy.

Strong leadership and decision-making skills.

Communicate effectively with customers and team members in a clear and professional manner

title: Warehouse Operations Specialist (3PL)
description:
About the Role
HEYTEA is seeking a detail-oriented Warehouse Operations Specialist (3PL) to support our U.S. supply chain operations at our third-party warehouse in Edison, New Jersey .This role oversees the day-to-day execution of warehouse services provided by our third-party logistics (3PL) partner, verifies inbound and outbound accuracy, reconciles inventory records, and coordinates carrier appointments and store shipment pickups.
You will work closely with our 3PL partner, transportation providers, and internal supply chain teams to maintain accurate inventory, resolve operational issues, and ensure reliable material supply to HEYTEA stores.

Key Responsibilities
Inbound Operations
Monitor receiving activities performed by the 3PL partner, including unloading, counting, and put-away.
Verify received quantities, SKUs, lot numbers, expiration dates, and receiving records against supporting documentation.
Investigate receiving discrepancies and follow up with relevant parties to ensure timely resolution.
Outbound Operations
Monitor order fulfillment activities, including picking, verification, packing, and loading, against store orders.
Conduct spot checks of SKUs, quantities, and store destination information to verify shipment accuracy.
Coordinate the resolution of incorrect items, missing items, short shipments, and other fulfillment discrepancies.
Inventory Control
Monitor the 3PL partner’s cycle counts and scheduled physical inventories.
Perform targeted inventory spot checks, investigate variances, and track corrective actions.
Verify lot and expiration-date records and monitor adherence to applicable inventory rotation procedures.
Inventory Data and Reconciliation
Review daily receiving and shipping transactions and reconcile WMS records with warehouse documentation and physical count results.
Identify and follow up on missing transactions, duplicate entries, quantity discrepancies, and other data issues.
Maintain timely, complete, and accurate operational records.
Carrier Scheduling and Coordination
Coordinate carrier appointments, pickup schedules, and loading handoffs with transportation providers and the 3PL partner.
Monitor shipment readiness against store delivery plans.
Address appointment delays, missed pickups, and loading exceptions, and escalate risks that may affect store supply.
Operational Issue Resolution
Monitor the 3PL partner’s adherence to established warehouse procedures and applicable product-handling, storage, and safety requirements.
Document and follow up on product damage, inventory variances, receiving and shipping errors, and transportation exceptions.
Coordinate corrective actions with responsible parties and verify completion.
Reporting and Cross-Functional Support
Prepare reports on inbound and outbound activity, inventory count results, shipment accuracy, and operational exceptions.
Share operational updates, recurring issues, and improvement recommendations with the U.S. supply chain team.
Support new-store material requirements, inventory reviews, and other related warehouse operations activities in collaboration with U.S. and headquarters teams.

Required Qualifications
At least two years of experience in warehousing, logistics, inventory control, or a related operational role.
Working knowledge of receiving, shipping, inventory counting, lot tracking, and inventory reconciliation processes.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience using a warehouse management system (WMS).
Ability to review operational data, identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and follow through on corrective actions.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and accountability for data accuracy.
Effective communication and coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate with warehouse partners, carriers, and internal teams.
Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese sufficient to communicate with U.S. warehouse and transportation partners and Mandarin-speaking headquarters colleagues.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience working on-site with, or overseeing service delivery by, a U.S. 3PL warehouse.
Experience in food and beverage supply chains, temperature-controlled warehousing, or cold chain operations.

title: Senior Franchise Business Development Manager
description:
HEYTEA USA | U.S. Franchise Expansion
Location: United States (Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Travel Requirements: Occasional domestic travel
Compensation: $120,000 – $220,000 annually (Base Salary)
About HEYTEA
HEYTEA is a globally recognized premium tea brand known for its innovative products, commitment to quality, and modern tea culture. As we continue expanding our presence across the United States, we are seeking an experienced and highly connected franchise business development professional to accelerate our franchise growth strategy and build a strong network of qualified franchise partners.

Position Overview
We are seeking a highly accomplished and results-driven Senior Franchise Business Development Manager to lead franchise partner acquisition and business expansion initiatives across the United States.
The ideal candidate brings an established network of prospective franchise investors, multi-unit operators, and strategic business partners, combined with a proven track record of successfully developing and closing franchise opportunities.
This role requires more than traditional business development experience. We are looking for a resourceful, commercially driven professional who can leverage existing relationships, develop innovative franchise recruitment strategies, identify untapped investor networks, and execute multiple acquisition channels to accelerate franchise growth.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong entrepreneurial thinking, exceptional relationship-building capabilities, and the ability to independently manage the entire franchise development lifecycle, from lead generation and investor engagement to negotiation and franchise agreement execution.
Key Responsibilities
1. Franchise Development & Market Expansion
Develop and execute comprehensive franchise recruitment and expansion strategies to accelerate HEYTEA's growth across the United States.
Identify, engage, qualify, and secure high-potential franchise partners, including individual investors, experienced franchise operators, multi-unit franchisees, and investment groups.
Build and manage a robust pipeline of qualified franchise prospects, driving opportunities from initial engagement through successful franchise agreement execution.
Identify priority geographic markets and franchise investment opportunities based on market potential, investor demand, and business growth objectives.
Establish measurable franchise development targets and consistently deliver against business expansion goals.
2. Strategic Networking & Investor Acquisition
Leverage an established professional network of franchise investors, multi-unit operators, restaurant groups, and business investment communities to generate qualified franchise opportunities.
Proactively cultivate relationships with high-net-worth individuals, family offices, franchise brokers, investment groups, and other potential franchise partners.
Build long-term strategic relationships with franchise industry associations, referral partners, business consultants, and relevant professional networks.
Represent HEYTEA at franchise exhibitions, investment conferences, industry networking events, and strategic business meetings.
Continuously expand the company's access to new investor communities and high-quality franchise development opportunities.
3. Multi-Channel Franchise Recruitment & Business Development
Design and implement diversified franchise lead-generation strategies beyond traditional inbound inquiries and franchise advertising.
Develop and optimize multiple franchise recruitment channels, including:
Direct investor outreach and relationship-based prospecting.
Franchise broker and referral networks.
Strategic partnerships with existing multi-unit franchise operators.
Franchise exhibitions, industry conferences, and investor networking events.
Digital franchise marketing and targeted lead-generation campaigns.
Business associations, investment communities, and professional networks.
Creative and nontraditional approaches to identifying qualified franchise investors.
Evaluate the effectiveness, cost efficiency, and conversion performance of different franchise acquisition channels.
Continuously introduce new business development methods and scalable franchise recruitment initiatives.
4. Franchise Sales, Negotiation & Deal Execution
Independently manage the franchise development process, including prospect qualification, initial consultation, investment discussions, business presentations, negotiation, and closing.
Assess prospective franchisees' financial qualifications, operational capabilities, business experience, and alignment with HEYTEA's brand standards.
Present franchise investment opportunities and communicate the brand's business model, competitive advantages, and growth potential.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Finance, Legal, and executive leadership, to facilitate franchise evaluation and agreement execution.
Support compliant franchise disclosure and agreement processes in coordination with legal counsel and relevant internal teams.
Maintain strong engagement with prospective franchisees throughout the sales cycle to improve conversion rates and shorten deal timelines.
5. Strategic Planning & Performance Management
Develop actionable franchise expansion plans with clearly defined priorities, milestones, and performance indicators.
Maintain accurate franchise development pipelines, investor profiles, engagement records, and deal forecasts.
Monitor and report key performance metrics, including qualified leads, pipeline value, conversion rates, signed agreements, and channel effectiveness.
Conduct competitive intelligence and market analysis to identify emerging franchise trends, investment opportunities, and potential strategic partnerships.
Provide leadership with actionable recommendations to improve franchise recruitment efficiency and accelerate business growth.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Hospitality Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Minimum 7 years of business development, franchise sales, or franchise expansion experience , including substantial direct responsibility for franchisee recruitment and acquisition.
Demonstrated success in franchise development within the United States , with a strong record of sourcing, negotiating, and securing franchise agreements.
An established and actively maintained network of franchise investors, multi-unit operators, franchise brokers, and/or strategic investment partners.
Proven ability to independently generate qualified franchise leads through existing relationships, proactive outreach, and diversified business development channels.
Extensive experience developing and executing franchise recruitment strategies, including both traditional and innovative acquisition methods.
Strong understanding of the U.S. franchise industry, franchise investment models, and the franchise development lifecycle.
Exceptional negotiation, consultative selling, relationship management, and deal-closing skills.
Strong commercial judgment, strategic thinking, and the ability to translate business opportunities into measurable results.
Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
Willingness and ability to travel domestically as business needs require.
Preferred Qualifications
Franchise development experience in the food and beverage, quick-service restaurant (QSR), fast-casual, specialty beverage, or hospitality industries.
Demonstrated success recruiting multi-unit and multi-brand franchise operators.
Existing relationships with established restaurant franchise groups, franchise investment firms, or experienced regional operators.
Experience supporting franchise expansion for emerging or rapidly growing consumer brands.
Proven success launching new franchise recruitment channels or significantly improving franchise lead conversion.
Experience developing strategic partnerships with franchise brokerage networks, investment groups, and industry organizations.
Experience expanding franchise networks across multiple U.S. states or major metropolitan markets.
Bilingual proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese is a plus, but not required.
What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will:
Build a sustainable and diversified pipeline of qualified franchise investors.
Convert established industry relationships into actionable franchise development opportunities.
Consistently achieve franchise recruitment and agreement execution targets.
Establish scalable, cost-effective franchise acquisition channels.
Expand HEYTEA's franchise partner network across priority U.S. markets.
Strengthen the company's long-term franchise development capabilities and competitive positioning.

Compensation & Work Arrangement
Annual Base Salary: $120,000 – $220,000
Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, demonstrated franchise development achievements, industry relationships, geographic location, and overall qualifications.
Work Arrangement: Remote, United States
Travel: Occasional domestic travel for investor meetings, franchise development activities, industry events, and business engagements.

Equal Employment Opportunity
HEYTEA USA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Supply Chain Supervisor（供应链专员）
description:
岗位职责（Job Responsibilities）
1. Local Sourcing & Supplier Management

Identify, evaluate, and develop local suppliers across various product categories to support business and operational needs.

Manage supplier relationships and assess product quality, pricing, service levels, delivery capabilities, and supply reliability.

Negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, and delivery arrangements to improve overall procurement value.

Maintain qualified backup suppliers and alternative sourcing options to mitigate supply disruptions.

2. Procurement Cost Optimization

Review existing supplier pricing and identify opportunities for cost savings and commercial improvement.

Compare sourcing options based on total landed cost, including product pricing, transportation, warehousing, handling, and potential product loss.

Develop cost comparison models and provide data-driven recommendations for procurement decisions.

Monitor market pricing and supplier performance to identify ongoing cost optimization opportunities.

3. Warehouse Inbound & Supply Chain Development

Establish and optimize inbound supply chains from local suppliers to designated warehouses, distribution centers, and store locations.

Coordinate with suppliers, warehouse partners, logistics providers, and internal teams to improve delivery efficiency and service reliability.

Evaluate transportation costs, delivery frequency, lead times, and warehouse handling requirements.

Develop standardized procurement and inbound processes to support business growth and operational efficiency.

4. Demand Forecasting & Inventory Planning

Analyze store demand, historical purchasing data, forecasted consumption, supplier lead times, and product shelf life to develop procurement plans.

Estimate purchasing quantities, replenishment frequency, inventory coverage, and turnover targets.

Balance product availability with inventory efficiency, minimizing stockouts, overstocking, and expiration-related losses.

Identify potential supply risks early and implement preventive actions to protect store operations.

5. Cross-functional Collaboration & Compliance

Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Product Development, Finance, and warehouse teams to align procurement plans with business needs.

Support new product launches and operational projects by evaluating material availability, sourcing feasibility, supplier readiness, and cost implications.

Ensure suppliers meet applicable quality, safety, regulatory, labeling, and handling requirements, including temperature-controlled storage and transportation standards where applicable.

Track procurement performance and prepare regular reports on cost savings, supplier performance, inventory, and supply risks.

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business, Food Science, or a related field preferred.
• 1+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier management, or supply chain operations; experience in food, beverage, restaurant, or retail industries is preferred.
• Experience sourcing dairy products, perishable ingredients, or other food-related commodities is a strong plus.
• Strong negotiation, analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
• Proficiency in Excel and data analysis; experience with ERP, inventory management, or procurement systems is preferred.
• Ability to analyze supplier quotations, transportation costs, inventory data, and total landed cost.
• Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Mandarin Chinese proficiency is preferred for communication with China-based teams and suppliers.
What Success Looks Like
• Improved local sourcing competitiveness and measurable procurement cost savings.
• Reliable supplier coverage and reduced risk of ingredient shortages.
• A standardized and cost-effective inbound supply chain.
• Improved inventory turnover and reduced expiration-related waste.
• Timely ingredient availability to support store operations and new product launches.

title: Operations Supervisor - Houston
description:
Job Overview
The Regional Store Operations Supervisor will oversee and manage the operations of multiple Heytea franchised stores within a specified region, ensuring operational excellence, team development, and brand consistency. This role focuses on both new store launches and the continuous improvement of existing stores.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in multi-unit management, demonstrated leadership abilities, and the drive to deliver exceptional customer service and business outcomes. We are looking for a dynamic individual with experience in fast-paced retail or food service environments who is adaptable to the evolving needs of our growing brand.

Key Responsibilities
Store Opening and Expansion
Participate in the planning and preparation of new store openings, including operational testing and compliance checks.
Ensure smooth and timely execution of new store launches, adhering to all regulatory requirements.
Store Standardization and Compliance
Conduct regular audits of stores to ensure compliance with Heytea's brand standards and local regulatory requirements, including health, safety, and labor laws.
Provide support to stores in managing inventory and equipment, tracking stock levels, and ensuring operational efficiency.
Guide store teams in product merchandising and presentation, conducting regular performance assessments to ensure brand alignment.
Store Performance Optimization
Collaborate with store managers to track and enhance sales performance, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
Assist in implementing and overseeing employee performance reviews and professional development plans to meet company objectives.

Exceptional problem-solving abilities, with a track record of independently addressing operational challenges and driving business results.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively manage relationships with store managers, team members, and business partners.
Demonstrated leadership in fostering team collaboration, motivation, and alignment with company goals.
Talent Development and Coaching
Experience in talent management, including team building, coaching, and developing high-performing store managers and staff.
Strong ability to mentor new leaders and provide guidance in operational best practices, ensuring that teams are aligned with the company’s vision and values.
Additional Requirements
Proficiency in financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance monitoring.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to the changing needs of a growing business.

title: Operations Supervisor - Bay Area
description:
Job Overview
The Regional Store Operations Supervisor will oversee and manage the operations of multiple Heytea franchised stores within a specified region, ensuring operational excellence, team development, and brand consistency. This role focuses on both new store launches and the continuous improvement of existing stores.
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in multi-unit management, demonstrated leadership abilities, and the drive to deliver exceptional customer service and business outcomes. We are looking for a dynamic individual with experience in fast-paced retail or food service environments who is adaptable to the evolving needs of our growing brand.
Key Responsibilities
Store Opening and Expansion
Participate in the planning and preparation of new store openings, including operational testing and compliance checks.
Ensure smooth and timely execution of new store launches, adhering to all regulatory requirements.
Store Standardization and Compliance
Conduct regular audits of stores to ensure compliance with Heytea's brand standards and local regulatory requirements, including health, safety, and labor laws.
Provide support to stores in managing inventory and equipment, tracking stock levels, and ensuring operational efficiency.
Guide store teams in product merchandising and presentation, conducting regular performance assessments to ensure brand alignment.
Store Performance Optimization
Collaborate with store managers to track and enhance sales performance, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
Assist in implementing and overseeing employee performance reviews and professional development plans to meet company objectives.
Monitor and elevate customer service levels, ensuring the delivery of Heytea's signature customer experience across all stores.
Team Development and Talent Management
Work with partners and store managers to build effective team structures, establishing clear roles, responsibilities, and career development pathways.
Provide ongoing training and mentorship to store managers and team members, promoting professional growth and operational excellence.
Facilitate leadership development programs and succession planning to ensure a pipeline of qualified talent for future expansion.
New Supervisor Onboarding and Development
Support the onboarding and training of new Regional Supervisors, providing them with the tools and knowledge needed to manage their assigned stores effectively.
Collaborate with the broader operations team to continuously improve training programs and operational processes.
Qualifications
Industry and Operational Experience
A minimum of 2 years of experience in multi-unit management, preferably in the food and beverage industry, with expertise in store operations, sales strategies, inventory control, and team leadership.
Proven ability to manage and optimize the operations of multiple store locations simultaneously, driving both top-line growth and operational efficiency.
Cross-Cultural and International Experience
Experience working in or managing operations in international markets is preferred, with a deep understanding of cultural diversity and the ability to adapt strategies to different regional markets.
Strong knowledge of U.S. labor laws, health and safety regulations, and employment standards, with experience ensuring compliance across multiple locations.
Bilingual in English and Chinese is preferred
Leadership and Problem-Solving Skills
Exceptional problem-solving abilities, with a track record of independently addressing operational challenges and driving business results.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively manage relationships with store managers, team members, and business partners.
Demonstrated leadership in fostering team collaboration, motivation, and alignment with company goals.
Talent Development and Coaching
Experience in talent management, including team building, coaching, and developing high-performing store managers and staff.
Strong ability to mentor new leaders and provide guidance in operational best practices, ensuring that teams are aligned with the company’s vision and values.
Additional Requirements
Proficiency in financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, and performance monitoring.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to the changing needs of a growing business.
